record.question: One who attacks
record.explanation: Answer C: agressor. The printed choice C is misspelled 'agressor'; it plainly denotes 'aggressor', a person who initiates an attack. 'Predator' can attack prey but is a narrower animal/preying role, while violator and samurai do not directly mean attacker. Preserve the printed spelling and explain it. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/aggressor Independently reviewed worked solution, unofficial; no examiner key is asserted.
